findings.section: Governance / scored-path data-plane identity (dispatch governance item: verify_positions-style freeze preconditions must gate the E run)
findings.evidence: (a) The dispatch names positions digests 85c8f875/57eed8b9/7eee7cf0 'from the S freeze'; grep over the entire stocks_search_v1_run tree and the worktree tests finds zero occurrences; those digests are the FOREX-SEARCH-V1 S-freeze digests (they appear in /Users/hoangminhlong/my-quantitative/.runtime/orchestrator_v3/inbox/fsearch-a7-prelaunch-r2-handoff.json and in a7_prelaunch_forex_search_v1_r2.json condition C-2). (b) The stocks S freeze does carry its own per-cell digests: arm_identity_sha256 d60cf26d.../6ccb3fa5.../f41e94a3... (gated) and pooled_series_stats.series_sha256 6fd58cc9.../495d9bca.../f55a14ba... (NOT gated anywhere). (c) i/i_engine.py verify_freeze() (lines 148-174) checks only the S-freeze file sha, status, arm identities, params and family; i/adjudicate.py load_real_data() (lines 563-607) takes cache_dir and retrieval_manifest_path as CALLER ARGUMENTS and verifies neither the committed retrieval_manifest.json sha (2c4283c2..., pinned in s/selection_freeze.json data_manifests_sha256 — verified 10/10 on disk by this audit) nor recomputed fired/bookable counts against the frozen p0_census.json rows, nor any positions/series digest. (d) The sibling FOREX cycle had verify_positions_vs_freeze() in code at its A7 (research/control/forex_search_v1_run/i/i_engine.py line 211, INPUT_MISMATCH fail-closed) and its AUTHORIZED_PRELAUNCH merely conditioned that it RUN AND PASS at E; the stocks chain has no analogous function to run.
findings.why: The scored E run is the irreversible budget-consuming step on the real 111,322-symbol plane. The data plane is live gitignored bytes under p0/raw/eod_cache; the vendor's living symbol list demonstrably drifted within hours during P0 (51,129 -> 51,131 between retrieval passes, run_log_r2.txt) and EODHD backfill/revision is documented in f9_artifact_digests.json's own raw_data_note. Without a load-time preflight binding the loaded plane to the frozen census (retrieval-manifest sha pin, per-cell census cross-check, and/or positions-series digest verification against the S freeze), a drifted cache would flow straight into scored numbers that reconcile with nothing, discoverable only post-hoc in phase R — after the budget is spent. The owner would be asked to type GO under the belief that a verify_positions-style control gates the run; no such control can fire. Under the mission invariant (identity must reconcile; missing evidence is NOT_RUN, never an inferred PASS) this is an unresolved HIGH on the scored path.
findings.required_remediation: Before the owner GO gate re-opens: implement, inside the sanctioned scored path (load_real_data or a dedicated preflight function it invokes), a fail-closed INPUT_MISMATCH preflight that (i) pins the retrieval manifest by sha256 against s/selection_freeze.json data_manifests_sha256, (ii) re-verifies the per-cell frozen preconditions using THIS chain's digests (arm_identity_sha256 x3 and the pooled position-count series digests 6fd58cc9.../495d9bca.../f55a14ba... from selection_freeze.json pooled_series_stats, rebuilt at load and compared), and (iii) cross-checks computed per-fold fired/bookable counts against the frozen p0_census.json rows for the 3 cells. Correct all dispatch/GO documentation to cite the stocks digests, not the forex ones. Then re-audit (delta scope sufficient).

findings.section: C-PIT-MUTATION structural expectation on persistent-state cells (adjudication of the disclosed handling)
findings.evidence: i_engine.pit_mutation_gate/pit_gate_core (lines 852-891): mutated(t) = state(t-1); PASS requires changed_or_refused == fired on EVERY fired decision. The three selected cells are high-persistence books: P0 census fired_day_share for 52W-HIGH-B10 is 0.576-0.715, GAP-P25-CONFIRM F1 fires ~74.8% of eligible name-sessions (23,665,926/30,633,726... config-level census), and VOL-REGIME terciles are persistent. For such states state(t-1) is usually also fired, so the gate is structurally expected to FAIL all three cells at E — the I handoff (ssearch-i-handoff.json known_limitations and i_engine.py docstring) discloses exactly this ('structurally fails persistent/consecutive-firing states such as 52W-HIGH on real data; the E adjudication will surface that honestly').
findings.why: Adjudication: the handling is integrity-preserving — the gate is applied verbatim, the failure direction is conservative (kills, never books), and genuine lookahead protection does not rest on this control (the Z dynamic battery D1 taint invariance 160/160, D2 doctored-future-bar with positive controls, D3 t+1-open proof, D5 no-same-bar-fill all PASS structurally). But the practical consequence must be visible before GO: the realistic terminal outcome of consuming the 3-cell budget is REJECT_ALL / STAGE_A_FAIL driven by a control whose failure mode is persistence, not evidence — the owner must authorize WITH that expectation, not discover it after the budget is spent. A FAIL-vs-NOT_ADJUDICABLE labeling choice (plan's disposition rule could read an invalid null for persistent states) does not change the non-bookable outcome; code is fail-closed under both readings.
findings.required_remediation: No code change. Carry an explicit owner-informed condition into GO: C-PIT-MUTATION is expected to structurally fail persistent-state cells; E budget may be consumed confirming structural kills; no post-hoc weakening or re-labeling of the gate is permitted in-cycle.
